title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B IQ2
description: NVIDIA Nemotron Bolt and LiLiCorr baked into the original Runpod vLLM worker. 32K context on RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96GB or its 48GB MIG partition. GPU presets adjust environment settings; hardware selection is separate. Current image GPU qualification required.

config.gpuIds: BLACKWELL_96,ADA_48_PRO,-NVIDIA L40,-NVIDIA L40S,-NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada Generation

input.name: Context window
input.description: Input plus generated tokens. Default 32768 targets RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96GB or its 48GB MIG partition. 32GB presets use 2048. Current image GPU acceptance is still required.

input.name: Faster startup (eager mode)
input.description: Skip Torch compilation and CUDA graph capture. Some kernel setup remains; generation throughput may be lower. Disable to restore compiled mode.

input.name: LiLiCorr speculative decoding
input.description: Use the stock worker SPECULATIVE_CONFIG with the baked LiLiCorr drafter. Off sends an empty value and omits the speculative flag.
